summary: VSee Health, Inc. (OTC: VSEE) executed a Strata Purchase Agreement with Clearthink Capital Partners, LLC, committing Clearthink to purchase up to $5.0 million of common stock at the Company's direction, subject to SEC registration effectiveness and other conditions. Sales may occur over approximately 36 months at the Company's sole discretion with no upper price limit. Clearthink has no obligation to purchase and may decline if the share price materially declines. The filing is a routine equity purchase agreement akin to an equity line of credit rather than a special situation.
